title: Figma UI Design Plan for a WhatsApp-like Chat Application

steps.title: Generate Figma UI Design Code
steps.description: Generate the Figma UI design code for a WhatsApp-like chat application. This includes multiple pages such as: Chat Screen (individual and group chats with text, emojis, media sharing, voice notes, document sharing, message reactions, replies, and forward options), Contact List (display contacts with profile pictures and status, search functionality), Status Updates (ability to view and post status updates with privacy settings), Calls (voice and video call functionality), Settings (profile customization, account settings, notifications, data and storage usage, help), and Profile (user profile display). The design should closely replicate the WhatsApp user interface and user experience. Output the design as a single, well-structured Figma file.
steps.note: This step requires a detailed understanding of Figma UI design principles and best practices to create a high-quality, functional, and visually appealing design.

steps.title: Generate Final Report
steps.description: Generate a final report summarizing the Figma UI design for the WhatsApp-like chat application. The report should include a description of each page, its functionality, and how it contributes to the overall user experience. Include screenshots of the Figma design to illustrate the key features and design elements. The report should be professional and well-organized.
steps.note: This is the final step, ensuring that the report accurately reflects the completed Figma UI design.
